[[agda]]
== Agda kernel proof

*`agda` · proof-executor · enforcing*

Check every MANIFEST module under the kernel flags, refuse unlisted .agda files, require reject fixtures to be refused on their marked line, after planted controls.

*Assurance boundary:* Pinned Agda 2.6.3 from the Ubuntu 24.04 archive and a MANIFEST are required; siblings come from a caller script the gate cannot verify; absence of the toolchain is exit 2, not success.

* link:../../actions/agda-check/action.yml[Action definition and inputs]
* link:../../.github/workflows/agda-gate.yml[Reusable workflow]
* link:../../templates/agda-gate-caller.yml[Caller template]

[[rocq]]
== Rocq assumptions

*`rocq` · proof-executor · enforcing*

Compile listed .v files with coqc and require every Print Assumptions to be closed, reports to equal prints and named theorems to be printed, after planted controls.

*Assurance boundary:* Pinned Coq 8.18.0 from the Ubuntu 24.04 archive is required; a theorem with no Print Assumptions is not examined, so name the theorems that matter.

* link:../../actions/rocq-check/action.yml[Action definition and inputs]
* link:../../.github/workflows/rocq-gate.yml[Reusable workflow]
* link:../../templates/rocq-gate-caller.yml[Caller template]

[[lean-axioms]]
== Lean axioms (standalone files)

*`lean-axioms` · proof-executor · enforcing*

Compile listed non-Lake .lean files and require every #print axioms to report no axioms, reports to equal prints and named theorems to be printed, after planted controls.

*Assurance boundary:* Pinned Lean 4.15.0 is required; Lake projects are proof-runner-check territory and are not judged here; a theorem with no #print axioms is not examined.

* link:../../actions/lean-axioms-check/action.yml[Action definition and inputs]
* link:../../.github/workflows/lean-axioms-gate.yml[Reusable workflow]
* link:../../templates/lean-axioms-gate-caller.yml[Caller template]

[[tla]]
== TLA+ model check

*`tla` · proof-executor · enforcing*

Run TLC on listed configs: must-pass configs must pass and must-refute configs must be refuted by the invariant named, after planted controls.

*Assurance boundary:* Pinned tla2tools.jar v1.7.4 and Java 21 are required; a model check is tested at its declared bounds, not proven.

* link:../../actions/tla-check/action.yml[Action definition and inputs]
* link:../../.github/workflows/tla-gate.yml[Reusable workflow]
* link:../../templates/tla-gate-caller.yml[Caller template]

[[proof-runner]]
== Idris2 & Lean proof runner

*`proof-runner` · proof-executor · tool-dependent*

Run applicable Idris2 project typechecks and Lean lake builds.

*Assurance boundary:* Not in default audit; a present project without its tool reports not_run, not success.

* link:../../actions/proof-runner-check/action.yml[Action definition and inputs]

[[idris2-abi]]
== Idris2 ABI source policy

*`idris2-abi` · policy-gate · enforcing*

When abi.ipkg exists, scan selected ABI source paths for prohibited IO/unsafe patterns.

*Assurance boundary:* Source-pattern check only: this action does not run the Idris2 compiler or establish formal purity.

* link:../../actions/idris2-abi-check/action.yml[Action definition and inputs]

[[zig-unified-api-adapter]]
== Zig adapter source policy

*`zig-unified-api-adapter` · policy-gate · enforcing*

Scan Zig files for direct std.fs/std.io usage prohibited by estate adapter policy.

*Assurance boundary:* Pattern check, not a Zig compiler invocation or proof of adapter correctness.

* link:../../actions/zig-unified-api-adapter-check/action.yml[Action definition and inputs]
